items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Well, Frances worked for me in '43.

ctx.x: And how about Frances and Neal, when did they work for you? Frances Wayne and Neal Hefti?

Well, Frances worked for me in '43. She was in that band. But she was there -- she wasn't there at the Park Central. Virginia Maxie was there. Frances joined the band -- she was there when Ralph Burns was with the band. Oh, wait a minute. Ralph Burns was there. It wasn't Dodo, Dodo came a little later. Ralph was still in the band there. Because I had heard her with her brother's band, and Ralph had been playing in that, and I wound up with both of them. And then Woody Herman stole Ralph from me, and then he wound…

with Frances. I used to break bands up. I mean it got -- it was -- of course at that time, I mean, I had a reason. I told you about the draft board, you know. It was a very uneasy thing. But I think I got my kicks out of building bands.
